scope: Specification and source-audit data only. No engine state, reward evaluator, search or training is implemented here.

boundary.logical_controllers: No off-map USSR or Commonwealth participant is created. Mongolia is directly controlled by the Comintern player and retains its separate identity.

politics.alliance_labels: Scoring and decision routing do not declare war, incorporate minors, merge national accounts, permit joint attacks, or bypass the Chinese Truce.

starting_accounts.authority: User authorized theatre-adjusted starting treasury; exact capped-local-base formula is a documented scenario derivation, not an official alternate setup.
starting_accounts.formula: For independent national accounts: min(official starting IPP, retained directly possessed original land printed IPP). Controlled and unaligned minors start with zero treasury.
starting_accounts.income_not_cash: Cash adjustment is not a war declaration or a full-production flag. Current income is the legally collectable recurring rate, including reachable modifiers, not the sum of printed IPP of every controlled minor.

completed_price_basis.note: Approved completed-asset policy recorded in the M0 README: setup, recruited and purchased units use full catalog value, subject to the existing remaining-repair-price deduction. Actual purchase discounts still change payments.

wealth.free_capital_ship_repair: Deducts zero IPP under the literal formula; do not invent a damage discount.
wealth.negative_facility_value: Possible under literal formula: Major Factory price18 minus repair20 equals -2. Null minimum means no clamp, not zero.

standalone_city_asset_value.note: The city label has no additional asset price. Count its legally collectable current income and distinct facilities.

wealth.deduplication: One physical facility ID or undirected rail border is one asset. Never count both paid construction and its completed replacement.

cross_owner_rail_attribution.rule: Half of one undirected border asset to each endpoint possessor; same-alliance endpoints aggregate once. Uncontrolled, unaligned minor shares count toward nobody. This is scoring only, not control or repair permission.

wealth.paid_construction_definition: cumulative_already_paid_ipp; replace with completed catalog asset value on completion; never count both

rule_reachability.reason: User excludes all convoys and convoy-raiding/loss/escort mechanics. Geographically local routes do not activate them; convoy audit is reference-only.

verification.scope: Specification, source data and map bridge only; not full-game mechanics or training.

freeze.revision_policy: Subsequent changes to the approved specification must explicitly revise the baseline.
